verdict.rationale: Baseten's core workflows—deploying models, training, inference, usage/budget monitoring—are all documented as CLI/API operations (truss push, baseten model push, config.yaml, Loops/Training Jobs API calls, usage queries by API key), suggesting strong API/CLI parity with the dashboard. However there's no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, and a probe for a public OpenAPI/swagger spec returned 404 on all candidate paths, indicating no discoverable comprehensive API reference to verify full coverage of UI actions like workspace/team management or billing configuration. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, a discoverable full API/OpenAPI spec, and evidence that non-inference admin/UI actions (billing setup, team management) are API-accessible.
